decision: Continue to the official release within the verified scope, following disclosure of the incomplete full-release conditions. Keep device, cloud, migration, upstream acceptance and performance gaps as published limitations; do not convert them into passed evidence.

limitations.upstream_acceptance: deveco-code baseline mapping changed; deveco-cli baseline receipt absent. Archived candidate proposals are not accepted upgrades.
limitations.migration: 28 migration rows remain pending; historical receipts do not establish acceptance of the current bytes.
limitations.specialized_acceptance: The 48-case complete acceptance matrix is not fully established for this release.
limitations.performance: The complete current 19-capability performance matrix is not established; controlled adapter measurements do not prove real-device performance.
limitations.device_and_cloud: Broader real-device, multi-display, SDK/platform combinations, cloud signing and expired authentication scenarios remain unverified.
limitations.evidence_transport: Full release-evidence/release workflow has no registered dedicated self-hosted import runner. This publication records its scoped validation separately and does not claim that workflow passed.

public_receipt: acceptance.json attached to v0.4.0; passed applies only to publication_scope
